title: Analista de integração
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Criar e manter integrações entre sistemas (usando APIs REST).
  • Desenvolver aplicações em .NET (C#).
  • Trabalhar com nuvem Azure (funções, serviços, armazenamento, mensageria, monitoramento).
  • Usar GitHub e pipelines CI/CD para versionamento e automação.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de código (SOLID, Clean Code).
  • Escrever testes automatizados e documentação técnica.
  • Atuar de forma ágil (Scrum, SAFe).


O que você precisa ter:

  • Pelo menos 4 anos de experiência com .NET (C#).
  • Experiência prática com metodologias ágeis.
  • Certificação AZ-104 (Azure Administrator).
  • Azure Functions
  • Azure App Services
  • Azure Key Vault
  • Azure Storage
  • Service Bus
  • Application Insights
  • Git/GitHub e CI/CD (GitHub Actions).
  • Criação e consumo de APIs REST.
  • Segurança com OAuth2 e JWT.
  • Integrações entre diferentes plataformas.
  • Testes automatizados (unitários e de integração).
  • Aplicação de Design Patterns e SOLID.
  • Escrita de código limpo e documentação técnica.
  • Inglês Avançado/Fluente


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: AI Engineer | Agents
description:
Estamos buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) de IA Generativa (Generative AI Engineer) para ser uma peça-chave no desenvolvimento e evolução da nossa plataforma de Agentic AI .


Na Bren, não construímos chatbots genéricos. Nosso produto é uma plataforma avançada de múltiplos agentes (vendas, suporte, insights) que orquestra conversas de alta performance no WhatsApp. Você será responsável por projetar, construir e otimizar os "cérebros" por trás dessas interações, transformando dados brutos de conversas em vendas reais e experiências hiper-personalizadas.


Sobre a Bren

A Bren é uma startup inovadora que transforma conversas em vendas, se comunicando com os clientes através do WhatsApp, 24 horas por dia. Acreditamos que equipes de vendas são essenciais para o crescimento de uma empresa, e por isso criamos soluções de automação e comunicação que aumentam a produtividade e tornam os processos mais eficientes. Nossa plataforma oferece funcionalidades como agendamento de reuniões, campanhas inteligentes, follow-up automatizado e muito mais, sempre com a voz da marca e com a inteligência da IA.


Responsabilidades

Sua missão será evoluir a inteligência central da nossa plataforma:


  • Desenvolver a Arquitetura Multi-Agente: Projetar, implementar e otimizar os agentes de IA (vendas, suporte, insights) e a "camada de inteligência unificada" que os orquestra.
  • Otimizar a Tomada de Decisão: Desenvolver a lógica que permite aos agentes interagir com sistemas de terceiros (ex: gateways de pagamento, calendários, CRMs) para executar tarefas complexas, como um "Frictionless Shopping Journey" dentro do WhatsApp.
  • Pesquisa e Inovação: Manter-se na vanguarda das técnicas de IA Generativa, testando e implementando novas arquiteturas de agentes, modelos e frameworks para garantir a liderança tecnológica da Bren.
  • Colaboração: Trabalhar em conjunto com o time técnico (backend, frontend, e arquitetura) para integrar as capacidades de IA de forma escalável e segura na nossa infraestrutura (FastAPI + GCP).


Stack de IA e Ferramentas


  • Linguagem Principal: Python
  • Frameworks de IA: LangChain, LlamaIndex, ou similares
  • Modelos: Experiência prática com APIs de LLMs e/ou modelos open-source
  • Bancos de Dados: Experiência com Bancos Vetoriais (Vector Databases) (ex: Pinecone, Chroma, PGVector) e SQL
  • Backend & Infra: FastAPI, Google Cloud Platform (GCP)


Perfil Ideal


  • Experiência Central: Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento e produção de sistemas de IA Generativa, especialmente com arquiteturas de agentes (Agentic AI) .
  • Conhecimento Técnico: Proficiência em Python e frameworks como LangChain (ou similares).
  • Domínio de RAG: Profundo conhecimento de técnicas de RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) , embeddings e o uso de Vector Databases .
  • Visão de Produto: Capacidade de traduzir desafios de negócios complexos (como vendas conversacionais) em soluções de IA robustas e escaláveis.
  • Infraestrutura: Familiaridade com Google Cloud Platform (GCP) (ou AWS/Azure), especialmente serviços relacionados a AI/ML.
  • Engenharia de Software: Experiência com desenvolvimento de APIs (idealmente FastAPI ) e boas práticas de engenharia para colocar modelos em produção.
  • Diferenciais: Experiência prévia com a API da Meta (WhatsApp Cloud API) e Whatsapp Flow é um grande diferencial.


Modalidade

  • Trabalho remoto

title: Estagiário IA
description:
Descrição da vaga

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Estagiária para se juntar ao nosso time e nos ajudar a construir soluções inteligentes, escaláveis e centradas em IA , apoiando o desenvolvimento de APIs, integrações com modelos de linguagem, infraestrutura de dados e sistemas modernos.

Você terá a oportunidade de aprender na prática, trabalhar com tecnologias de última geração e participar ativamente em soluções que utilizam IA para transformar experiências dos nossos clientes.


Principais Atividades

O estagiário terá a oportunidade de trabalhar diretamente com as tecnologias mais atuais no campo de IA, focando em:

  • Desenvolvimento de APIs e Serviços de IA
  • Auxiliar na programação e manter APIs que consomem e orquestram serviços de IA (Bedrock, LLMs, Models as a Service).
  • Integrar e realizar testes em modelos de Machine Learning e IA através de APIs e SDKs.
  • Implementação de Soluções Baseadas em RAG
  • Auxiliar na construção e manutenção de sistemas RAG, incluindo o processamento de dados e a integração com Vector S3 e bancos de dados vetoriais.
  • Implementação de endpoints utilizando melhores práticas.
  • Suporte à Infraestrutura e Dados
  • Colaborar na manutenção e otimização de sistemas e na manipulação de dados para fine-tuning e prompt engineering.
  • Trabalhar com a equipe de engenharia de dados e MLOps para garantir a qualidade e disponibilidade dos datasets de IA.


Requisitos Fundamentais da posição

  • Para esta posição, buscamos um(a) estagiário(a) com base sólida em programação e interesse genuíno em sistemas de IA. É obrigatório possuir:
  • Fundamentos de Programação e Web
  • Sólida proficiência em Python e conhecimento em desenvolvimento de sistemas backend para web (APIs/Serviços).
  • Habilidade para projetar, consultar e manipular dados em Bancos de Dados Relacionais (Ex: MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB).
  • Desenvolvimento e Versionamento
  • Conhecimento em versionamento de código utilizando Git (git-flow, branching, commits).
  • Familiaridade com APIs REST e conceitos de arquitetura de software para web.
  • Noções de Computação em Nuvem
  • Conhecimento básico sobre a arquitetura e serviços da Amazon Web Services (AWS).
  • Diferenciais (O que vai te destacar)
  • Conhecimentos ou projetos práticos nos seguintes itens serão um grande diferencial:
  • IA Generativa e LLMs: Noções de utilização ou integração com serviços como AWS Bedrock ou modelos de linguagem (LLMs).
  • Frameworks de Python: Experiência ou familiaridade com o framework FastAPI para construção de APIs de alta performance.
  • Agentes de IA: Conhecimento no uso de SDKs ou frameworks de agentes, como Strands Agents SDK.
  • Recuperação de Informação: Noções de sistemas RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), bancos de dados vetoriais (Vector Databases), e armazenamento em Vector S3.

title: Client Services, Interpretation (Language Services | Research | Due Diligence | Remote)
description:
About Us

Cadence ( is a language services firm servicing the due diligence industry. We started in Beijing in 2014 and the types of clients we serve are expert networks, investment firms, consulting firms and market research firms. We are a remote-first company whose staff is located across multiple countries. Each individual is functionally aligned to one of three time zones (APAC, EMEA, Americas). We strive to promote internally whenever possible, so this is a limited opportunity to join a company that values ambitious and efficient professionals keen to develop their career.


Key Responsibilities

You are a project manager for our interpretation team. Your job title would be Associate on our Client Service team. The full career track associated with this role can be seen on our careers page.


You'll play a key role in ensuring clients' interpretation and market research needs are met with precision and efficiency. Your responsibilities will centre around three core areas: project management, client communication, and ad-hoc recruitment of specialized language professionals. As you master these core functions, opportunities may arise for managing more complex projects, assuming enhanced client-facing roles, and collaborating with Client Service Managers on strategic planning, furthering your growth within the Client Services team.


Our interpretation team covers both remote projects and on-site projects.


Note - this role is to manage interpretation projects, not to actually interpret on behalf of clients.



The Job


You will manage multiple projects per day.


Projects can begin and end on the same day (”I need an interpreter for a call at 8pm tonight”).


Or they can span several weeks (”I am hosting three focus groups in three Chinese cities and need moderators to facilitate the focus groups and translate the output into English”).


Here’s how you will interact with a project:


Scoping

  • You will speak with clients via email, phone, or WeChat about their needs
  • You will work with colleagues to ensure the client’s expectations for quality, speed, and cost are met
  • You will identify colleagues to assist based on the relevant time zones or regions for the project

Matchmaking

  • Your top responsibility is to identify the best linguist in our community for the client’s objective
  • You will need to present that linguists’ experience in a relevant way for the project
  • ... or you will need to recruit a new one if there isn’t an ideal match
  • You will need to constantly evaluate profitability and client satisfaction

Executing

  • You will need to sync up expectations between client(s) and linguist(s)
  • You may need to chaperone calls to ensure they begin successfully
  • You will need to speak with clients after projects to make sure they are satisfied

Key Requirements


  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field
  • Fluency in English. Fluency in an additional language is a bonus.
  • Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM systems
  • Excellent written and verbal communication and client service skills
  • Strong organizational and multitasking abilities
  • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment
  • Ability to work effectively in both independent and team environments
  • Goal-oriented, driven, and highly motivated to succeed & take on challenges
  • Entry-level to intermediate-level candidates are welcome to apply: any relevant work experience is a plus


Working Hours & Location


  • This is a fully-remote role where you can work from home (WFH )
  • You will work either APAC, AMER or EMEA business hours , but wherever possible, it will be your local region (eg - LatAm applicants will work AMER hours)
  • Weekends and overnights shifts are available with a commensurate increase in compensation.


Compensation & Benefits

  • Salary commensurate with experience
  • Paid time off
  • Health insurance
  • Annual allowance for professional development expenses

title: ANALISTA DE MEDICAL AFFAIRS PLENO
description:
A Gi Group em parceria com laboratório farmacêutico, contrata:

ANALISTA DE MEDICAL AFFAIRS PLENO

Responsabilidades:

  • Apoio em todos os processos da área médica;
  • Atualização de apresentações (slide decks) para diferentes especialidades médicas;
  • Responsável por iniciar o processo de C3 para iniciativas médicas;
  • Elaboração de convites para sessões científicas;
  • Apoio no preenchimento de formulários de briefing para eventos médicos ou patrocínios;
  • Apoio no cálculo de honorários de palestrantes para eventos médicos e iniciativas cross-functional;
  • Suporte na criação de apresentações institucionais para o departamento médico;
  • Responsável pela revisão mensal de literatura científica sobre temas relevantes, incluindo leitura completa dos artigos e organização em planilha para atualização do time multifuncional;

Requisitos:

  • Formação Superior na área da saúde: Biologia, Biomedicina, Farmácia ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência prévia na área da saúde, especialmente com: Atendimento em call center especializado, voltado a profissionais da saúde. Informações médicas (Infomed), farmacovigilância e Regulatório.
  • Familiaridade com PubMed e outras bases científicas.
  • Capacidade de realizar análise crítica de artigos científicos, com foco em elaboração de apresentações (slides).
  • Inglês intermediário.

Vaga home office com idas esporádicas ao escritório.

Local de trabalho: Zona Sul - São Paulo

Horário: SEGUNDA À QUINTA DAS 8H AS 17H55 - FLEXÍVEL e SEXTA DAS 8H AS 15H

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Python Sênior (FastAPI)
description:
Desenvolvedor(a) Python Sênior (FastAPI) | Você está construindo o futuro da IA ou apenas mais um CRUD?


Seu domínio de Python e FastAPI está sendo usado para quê?

Se a resposta for "apenas mais um microsserviço CRUD", temos um desafio para você.

Estamos procurando um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Python Sênior que não queira apenas construir APIs rápidas, mas que queira construir a espinha dorsal de sistemas de Inteligência Artificial de ponta.


Buscamos alguém para atuar na intersecção exata entre engenharia de software de alta performance (com FastAPI) e a vanguarda da IA — estamos falando de orquestração de Agentes de IA , integração de modelos e arquiteturas RAG .


Você será o pilar técnico responsável por desenhar e escalar os microsserviços que dão vida à nossa inteligência.


O que você vai fazer aqui:

  • Projetar e escalar APIs assíncronas (FastAPI) que aguentam o tranco.
  • Colaborar DIRETAMENTE com Cientistas de Dados para otimizar a inferência de modelos.
  • Arquitetar e construir os serviços que gerenciam o ciclo de vida de Agentes de IA.
  • Ser a referência técnica, mentorando a equipe e garantindo a excelência do código (testes, performance, design patterns).


O que esperamos de você (O Essencial):

  • Experiência sênior real em Python e profundo conhecimento prático em FastAPI (Pydantic, async/await, injeção de dependência).
  • Arquitetura de microsserviços e design patterns no sangue.
  • Mestre em bancos de dados (PostgreSQL e Redis).
  • Código limpo, testável e uma mentalidade ágil (Git, Scrum/Kanban).


O que vai te destacar (Diferenciais "UAU"):

  • Experiência (ou paixão comprovada) em IA/ML/NLP .
  • Conhecimento prático em frameworks de Agentes (LangChain , AutoGPT, etc.).
  • Experiência com Bancos de Dados Vetoriais e arquiteturas RAG .
  • Vivência em Cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure), Docker/Kubernetes e Filas (Kafka/RabbitMQ).
  • Conhecimento em TypeScript/JavaScript.


Se você está cansado do "tradicional" e quer construir o "próximo nível" do software, queremos conversar com você.. Candidate-se agora.


Local de trabalho: 100% remoto

Modelo de contratação: PJ

title: Arquiteto de soluções sênior
description:
Modelo de trabalho: Remoto

Contratação: CLT


Sobre a oportunidade

Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional com perfil híbrido entre Arquitetura e Desenvolvimento de Soluções , com forte base técnica, visão sistêmica e atuação prática. Buscamos alguém que una estratégia e execução , participando ativamente da definição, construção e evolução de soluções escaláveis, seguras e integradas , contribuindo para decisões técnicas e disseminação de boas práticas no time.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições

  • Desenhar e evoluir arquiteturas de sistemas distribuídos, APIs e aplicações web modernas ;
  • Apoiar o time de desenvolvimento em decisões técnicas, revisões de código e boas práticas de engenharia ;
  • Propor soluções aderentes ao negócio , garantindo qualidade, segurança, escalabilidade e performance;
  • Atuar na integração entre sistemas, serviços e bancos de dados , promovendo eficiência e consistência;
  • Desenvolver componentes críticos de backend, frontend e middlewares , com foco em performance e manutenibilidade;
  • Definir e apoiar práticas de versionamento, automação e implantação (CI/CD) ;
  • Explorar novas tecnologias e ferramentas que contribuam para otimização e evolução contínua do ecossistema técnico.


Stack e Ferramentas

Backend: .NET (C#), Python, Node.js (TypeScript/JavaScript)

Frontend: React (componentização, gerenciamento de estado e boas práticas)

Bancos de Dados: SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis

Mensageria: RabbitMQ

Infraestrutura: Docker, Docker Compose, Git, pipelines CI/CD

Arquitetura: Microserviços, APIs RESTful, Event-Driven Architecture, Cloud-ready

Diferenciais: Autenticação (OAuth, JWT), testes automatizados, observabilidade (logs, métricas, tracing)


Perfil Comportamental

  • Mentalidade de dono e foco em resultados ;
  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de traduzir decisões técnicas em linguagem de negócio ;
  • Espírito colaborativo e desejo de elevar o nível técnico do time;
  • Autonomia e proatividade na resolução de problemas;
  • Curiosidade e aprendizado contínuo , buscando sempre novas abordagens e soluções.


Por que fazer parte da TIVIT

Na TIVIT, você fará parte de uma equipe que acredita na inovação como motor de transformação , com liberdade para propor, testar e construir soluções que impactam grandes negócios . Aqui, valorizamos profissionais que unem visão estratégica, capacidade técnica e atitude protagonista .

title: Desenvolvedor (a) PL
description:
Transformar o varejo da construção civil com tecnologia, inteligência e propósito — esse é o nosso negócio.


A Juntos Somos Mais nasceu em 2018 como uma startup de tecnologia com um sonho grande: impulsionar o setor de material de construção em todo o Brasil, conectando indústria, varejo e profissionais da obra por meio de um ecossistema de soluções inovadoras.


Com o apoio dos nossos acionistas — Votorantim Cimentos, Gerdau e Tigre —, movimentamos mais de R$10 bilhões em nossa Loja Virtual em 2024, impactando mais de 100 mil lojas e 1,2 milhão de membros entre lojistas, vendedores e profissionais de obra.


Somos movidos por um time diverso, inquieto e protagonista — gente que sonha grande, age com autonomia e coloca o cliente no centro de tudo. Aqui, valorizamos quem se dedica a entender as dores reais do varejo e busca, com consistência, soluções que gerem valor e resultados para os nossos usuários.


Se você tem perfil empreendedor, é apaixonado por construir soluções com foco no cliente e quer deixar sua marca em um dos setores mais importantes do país, chega mais.


O futuro do varejo da construção civil tá sendo construído agora — e pode ser com você.

title: Key Account Manager (AME)
description:
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced B2B Key Account Manager with a background in the travel industry, to join our team. As a Key Account Manager, you will be responsible for building and maintaining strong relationships with our key clients, ensuring their needs are met, and driving business growth.


About the Role - Main Responsibilities:


  • In Charge of Existing Clients (API Wholesale Online - API Retail Offline - WebShopping Account) Within the assigned territory.
  • Develop and implement strategic account plans to achieve sales targets, foster account growth, and identify new business opportunities.
  • Acquisition of new key accounts within the assigned territory.
  • Conduct regular business reviews with clients to assess their needs, address concerns, and provide solutions that meet their objectives.
  • Identify upselling and cross-selling opportunities within existing accounts to maximize revenue generation.
  • Prepare and present reports on account performance, sales forecasts, and market insights.
  • Collaborate with product development teams to provide feedback and insights from clients, contributing to the development of new products/services.
  • Stay updated on industry trends, market conditions, and competitor activities to proactively identify potential threats and opportunities.


Qualifications - Position Requirements:


  • Strong influencing and negotiation skills, thriving in the creation and maintenance of successful long-term commercial relationships with clients and other stakeholders.
  • Experienced with proven ability to deliver results in an autonomous working environment.
  • Solid experience and commercial knowledge of the travel & hospitality industries.
  • Commercially good knowledge of business for B2B, as well as new business segments and models.
  • Project management skills.
  • Proficiency in English and Portuguese as working languages is required. Fluency in Spanish is a plus.

title: Senior Project Manager
description:
Senior Project Manager


**Add resumes in English**


In this role, you will collaborate with key infrastructure stakeholders and business partners in defining project scope, interpreting requirements and priorities, and leading the modernization and transformation of systems. The projects you lead will primarily include infrastructure and application integrations and other infrastructure initiatives. Ideally you are highly skilled in communicating with technical teams, business stakeholders, and C-Suite Executives and you have a well-rounded understanding of the various components of an enterprise IT environment.


Responsabilities:

• Drive project management decisions, governance, and long-term vision.

• Analyze divisional business requirements and translate these into technical deliverables organized as Executive Milestones (In/Out of Scope).

• Develop expert 'As Is' knowledge of platform systems and help define 'To Be' system solutions and flows (e.g., must understand before planning).

• Understand infrastructure requirements and deployment of solutions for OnPrem and Cloud Computing service models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS).

• Analyze data to identify key insights and apply them to the business; quantitative and qualitative analysis.

• Ensure coordination of teams to drive timely completion of deliverables of large projects.

• Manage project budgets and financials, including resource allocations supporting a project’s schedule.

• Define and provide KPI’s and metrics for assigned projects.

• Interact closely with stakeholders and vendors and provide communications to executive management.

• Operationally troubleshoot or lead the troubleshooting of complex issues.

• Proactively ensure compliance (processes, standards, methodology) with expected quality.

• Responsible for project-related organizational change management including communications, training, and adoption.

• General understanding of infrastructure requirements to deploy solutions for storage, middleware, DB, voice specifics (call/contact centers), and network (routers, switches, firewalls, load balancing, WAF).

• Definition, implementation, and adoption of processes.


Requirements:

• Advanced English (mandatory)

• Bachelor’s degree and solid experience in Project/Program Management.

• Experience managing merger and acquisition infrastructure and application integration or divestiture projects preferred.

• Project Management Professional and/or Certified Scrum Master preferred.

• Experience managing requirements for multiple large, complex, and cross functional projects. Emphasis on systems, technologies, business process redesign, and knowledge of technical environments.

• Experience producing detailed project plans and resource requirements.

• Exceptional verbal and written communication skills – must be comfortable speaking and writing interacting with C-level audiences, as well as technical and non-technical audiences.

• Excellent communication, interpersonal, organizational, and negotiation skills.

• Proven ability to write business requirements, including user stories, use case development and work-flow documentation.

• Product and project management skills; business judgment, including ability to balance resources, evaluate and address risks, and concisely articulate where trade-off decisions are to be made.

• Strong orientation to user-base, including ability to understand needs and apply this knowledge to product enhancements, online user experience, and communication content (internal and external).

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Who We Are?

Softensity is a US-based IT outsourcing company with global software teams. We are headquartered in Atlanta, GA, USA with development teams in LATAM, Eastern Europe and Türkiye. When you have better teams, you build better software. Let’s do this together!


We are currently seeking a dynamic and inquisitive Senior Software Engineer with strong technical skills and the ability to navigate organizational dynamics, with of adaptability and foundational knowledge in security applications


The Project:

Our client’s platform runs on the Microsoft Azure cloud and follows a microservices architecture. They run a mix of open source, vendor-licensed, and internally developed tools to perform functions such as provisioning, software deployment, logging, and monitoring.

You'll learn these tools and have opportunities to improve them. The team is collaborative; they work closely with the development teams and support to deliver the best results for the organization. The goal is to balance the best solution with the need to get things done for each engineering challenge we face.


Technical Skills:

Must have

  • Proficiency in .NET Core
  • Proficiency in Cloud (ideally Azure , but AWS or GCP are acceptable)
  • Strong background in Microservices architecture
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Bicep , ARM templates , Terraform , or Pulumi
  • Experience with Event Hubs , Service Bus , or similar
  • Knowledge of Container Apps , Function Apps , App Services
  • Experience with Storage Accounts , CDN , Subscriptions , Resource Groups
  • Understanding of App Insights , Log Analytics
  • Experience managing RBAC , Managed Identities , SPNs , App Registrations
  • Hands-on experience with Docker
  • Database skills with Azure SQL, MongoDB, SQL, and Cosmos DB

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD tools
  • Familiarity with cloud automation , especially infrastructure automation
  • Comfortable exploring Infrastructure as Code (IaC) , Developer Experience (DX) , UI , and architecture as necessary
  • Familiarity with widely used Azure resources , including ASB/Event Hub , AKS/ACA , Storage Account


Why Join Us?

We are passionate about top quality talent and giving our team members the tools they need for them to keep on growing and learning. The sky is truly the limit and we want you to feel challenged and motivated in every single project that you're a part of all while working with cutting edge technologies and amazing clients.


What to expect?

  • Coursera credentials
  • Remote work
  • Learning opportunities

We are currently seeking a dynamic and inquisitive Senior Software Engineer with strong technical skills and the ability to navigate organizational dynamics, with of adaptability and foundational knowledge in security applications


The Project:

Our client’s platform runs on the Microsoft Azure cloud and follows a microservices architecture. They run a mix of open source, vendor-licensed, and internally developed tools to perform functions such as provisioning, software deployment, logging, and monitoring.

You'll learn these tools and have opportunities to improve them. The team is collaborative; they work closely with the development teams and support to deliver the best results for the organization. The goal is to balance the best solution with the need to get things done for each engineering challenge we face.

Must have

  • Proficiency in .NET Core
  • Proficiency in Cloud (ideally Azure , but AWS or GCP are acceptable)
  • Strong background in Microservices architecture
  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Bicep , ARM templates , Terraform , or Pulumi
  • Experience with Event Hubs , Service Bus , or similar
  • Knowledge of Container Apps , Function Apps , App Services
  • Experience with Storage Accounts , CDN , Subscriptions , Resource Groups
  • Understanding of App Insights , Log Analytics
  • Experience managing RBAC , Managed Identities , SPNs , App Registrations
  • Hands-on experience with Docker
  • Database skills with Azure SQL, MongoDB, SQL, and Cosmos DB

Nice to have

  • Familiarity with GitHub Actions or similar CI/CD tools
  • Familiarity with cloud automation , especially infrastructure automation
  • Comfortable exploring Infrastructure as Code (IaC) , Developer Experience (DX) , UI , and architecture as necessary
  • Familiarity with widely used Azure resources , including ASB/Event Hub , AKS/ACA , Storage Account

title: Salesforce
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


O que esperar do seu dia a dia de trabalho

  • Ser o especialista técnico em Salesforce para as equipes internas.
  • Desenvolver e integrar soluções dentro das plataformas Salesforce (Marketing Cloud, Pardot, Commerce Cloud e Experience Cloud).
  • Trabalhar com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, SAFe).
  • Criar e usar APIs para integrar o Salesforce com o Azure.
  • Gerenciar código e automações com GitHub e CI/CD (GitHub Actions).
  • Produzir documentação técnica clara.
  • Colaborar com equipes internas para entender necessidades e validar entregas.


O que você precisa ter:

  • Mínimo de 4 anos de experiência com Salesforce.
  • Domínio de Marketing Cloud, Pardot, Commerce Cloud e Experience Cloud.
  • Experiência com Scrum ou SAFe.
  • Saber usar GitHub e pipelines de CI/CD (GitHub Actions).
  • Experiência com integrações via API entre Salesforce e Azure.
  • Boa habilidade de documentação técnica.
  • LWC (Lightning Web Components)
  • Apex (classes e triggers)
  • Flow
  • Experience Cloud Builder
  • Integração com APIs externas
  • Salesforce Commerce Cloud
  • Flosum
  • Objetos padrão e personalizados
  • Conhecimento em Snowflake (banco de dados na nuvem).
  • Inglês Avançado/Fluente


Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office


Benefícios para você:

  • Vale Refeição
  • Vale Alimentação
  • Assistência Médica
  • Assistência Odontológica
  • Seguro de Vida
  • Gym Pass
  • Auxílio Pet


Além disso, oferecemos:

  • Incentivo a estudo após completar 1 ano de Dexian
  • Programa de desenvolvimento e treinamentos
  • Formação através da Trilha de Liderança

title: Sr. Technical Customer Success Analyst
description:
Title: Sr. Customer Support Analyst

Business Unit: Graphic Communications

Location: Brazil, Remote


Graphic Communications( a CAI Division) is a leading global provider of industry-specific business and production software technology for print industries. Graphic Communications ’s integrated and automated software offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With several offices worldwide, and over thirty-years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the printing industries, it is our deeply held philosophy that Graphic Communications succeeds when our customers thrive. For more information, visit us at


As a Sr. Customer Support Analyst , you will troubleshoot complex customer requests, manage the global support queue and backlog, and ensure exceptional, timely service for our valued customers. Reporting directly to the Sr. Manager, Customer Success , you will play a crucial role in driving customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term success.

In this role, you will combine your technical expertise, analytical thinking, and customer-focused mindset to deliver high-quality solutions to critical support issues. You will act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, collaborating closely with internal teams to diagnose, resolve, and prevent recurring issues.


Your key responsibilities include delivering specialized technical solutions to escalated support cases, providing a proactive, personalized customer experience, and strengthening the partnership between the Customer Support Team and Graphic Communication’s clients through technical excellence and accountability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Answer incoming telephone calls and open cases in Salesforce, identifying customers, populating case details, and confirming data accuracy.
  • Monitor the Global Support queue and accept Salesforce cases in priority sequence.
  • Review case priority and maintain strict adherence to SLA requirements based on severity and impact.
  • Troubleshoot customer-reported issues, identify root causes, and provide timely solutions via case updates, calls, or screen-sharing sessions.
  • Provide customer support via email, Teams, and telephone using discretion, experience, and technical judgment.
  • Escalate or re-route cases to appropriate Tier 2 or Tier 3 teams after thorough investigation while maintaining SLA compliance.
  • Allocate resources, systems, and solutions to ensure efficient issue resolution.
  • Identify customers’ operational and business challenges, guiding them and the Graphic Communications team toward effective resolutions.
  • Document and submit solutions to the knowledge base with complete technical and procedural details.
  • Close cases with accurate and comprehensive resolution documentation.
  • Collaborate closely with R&D and Services teams to replicate and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Test, analyze, organize, and report progress on ongoing customer cases.
  • Ensure accountability and progress tracking through Salesforce reporting and analytics.
  • Manage and prioritize active support cases within your queue while maintaining strong communication with customers.
  • Make informed case routing decisions, escalating appropriately based on technical complexity.
  • Follow up with clients on outstanding queries and provide proactive updates.
  • Notify clients about new software releases, coordinating with Marketing to ensure customers are informed of relevant fixes and improvements.
  • Collaborate with Tiered Support peers and Development teams for environment setup, database capture, and other technical tasks as required.


Technical Troubleshooting Responsibilities

  • Use Chrome Developer Tools (Inspector) to analyze web applications, review network requests, debug front-end issues, and identify JavaScript or API failures.
  • Perform API testing and validation using tools such as Postman or cURL.
  • Conduct IIS and SSL diagnostics to investigate and resolve issues on Windows Application Servers.
  • Configure and troubleshoot Windows ADFS Servers and perform remote diagnostics via VPN, RDP, or similar tools.
  • Assist customers with database backups, migrations, and SQL troubleshooting using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), write scripts, stored procedures, and queries.
  • Utilize network tracing tools (e.g., Wireshark, Fiddler) to diagnose connectivity, latency, or certificate-related issues.
  • Perform log analysis across web, application, and system logs to identify root causes of performance or access issues.
  • Understanding of web deployment and troubleshooting for ASP.NET-based applications and related components.
  • Maintain proficiency in analyzing browser console errors, network calls, and response payloads to pinpoint issues in customer environments.
  • Participate in proactive system health checks, monitoring server performance metrics and application uptime indicators.


Experience Requirements

  • Minimum 8+ years of customer support experience.
  • ERP/MIS background preferred.
  • Print industry knowledge is mandatory.
  • Experience with tools such as Salesforce, JIRA, and Confluence preferred.
  • Strong understanding of support operations and troubleshooting methodologies.
  • Ability to solve problems efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Self-starter with the ability to work with minimal guidance.
  • Confident in delegating tasks and providing peer guidance.
  • Willing to work in shifts as required.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Strong documentation and organizational abilities.
  • Data analysis skills (reports, dashboards, and metrics).
  • Proficient in general computing, internet research, and email communication.
  • Understanding of web development, SSO, Active Directory, and SSL.
  • Hands-on experience with VPN configuration, network management, and SQL scripting.


Education

  • Degree in Technology, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent hands-on experience in customer support and enterprise systems.
  • Strong understanding of software troubleshooting, printing workflows, and IT infrastructure preferred.

Graphic Communications ’s integrated and automated software offerings and point solutions are designed to enable revenue growth and drive operating and production efficiencies. With several offices worldwide, and over thirty-years dedicated to delivering best-in-class technology to the printing industries, it is our deeply held philosophy that Graphic Communications succeeds when our customers thrive. For more information, visit us at


As a Sr. Customer Support Analyst , you will troubleshoot complex customer requests, manage the global support queue and backlog, and ensure exceptional, timely service for our valued customers. Reporting directly to the Sr. Manager, Customer Success , you will play a crucial role in driving customer satisfaction, retention, and long-term success.

In this role, you will combine your technical expertise, analytical thinking, and customer-focused mindset to deliver high-quality solutions to critical support issues. You will act as a trusted technical advisor to customers, collaborating closely with internal teams to diagnose, resolve, and prevent recurring issues.


Your key responsibilities include delivering specialized technical solutions to escalated support cases, providing a proactive, personalized customer experience, and strengthening the partnership between the Customer Support Team and Graphic Communication’s clients through technical excellence and accountability.


Key Responsibilities

  • Answer incoming telephone calls and open cases in Salesforce, identifying customers, populating case details, and confirming data accuracy.
  • Monitor the Global Support queue and accept Salesforce cases in priority sequence.
  • Review case priority and maintain strict adherence to SLA requirements based on severity and impact.
  • Troubleshoot customer-reported issues, identify root causes, and provide timely solutions via case updates, calls, or screen-sharing sessions.
  • Provide customer support via email, Teams, and telephone using discretion, experience, and technical judgment.
  • Escalate or re-route cases to appropriate Tier 2 or Tier 3 teams after thorough investigation while maintaining SLA compliance.
  • Allocate resources, systems, and solutions to ensure efficient issue resolution.
  • Identify customers’ operational and business challenges, guiding them and the Graphic Communications team toward effective resolutions.
  • Document and submit solutions to the knowledge base with complete technical and procedural details.
  • Close cases with accurate and comprehensive resolution documentation.
  • Collaborate closely with R&D and Services teams to replicate and resolve complex technical issues.
  • Test, analyze, organize, and report progress on ongoing customer cases.
  • Ensure accountability and progress tracking through Salesforce reporting and analytics.
  • Manage and prioritize active support cases within your queue while maintaining strong communication with customers.
  • Make informed case routing decisions, escalating appropriately based on technical complexity.
  • Follow up with clients on outstanding queries and provide proactive updates.
  • Notify clients about new software releases, coordinating with Marketing to ensure customers are informed of relevant fixes and improvements.
  • Collaborate with Tiered Support peers and Development teams for environment setup, database capture, and other technical tasks as required.


Technical Troubleshooting Responsibilities

  • Use Chrome Developer Tools (Inspector) to analyze web applications, review network requests, debug front-end issues, and identify JavaScript or API failures.
  • Perform API testing and validation using tools such as Postman or cURL.
  • Conduct IIS and SSL diagnostics to investigate and resolve issues on Windows Application Servers.
  • Configure and troubleshoot Windows ADFS Servers and perform remote diagnostics via VPN, RDP, or similar tools.
  • Assist customers with database backups, migrations, and SQL troubleshooting using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS), write scripts, stored procedures, and queries.
  • Utilize network tracing tools (e.g., Wireshark, Fiddler) to diagnose connectivity, latency, or certificate-related issues.
  • Perform log analysis across web, application, and system logs to identify root causes of performance or access issues.
  • Understanding of web deployment and troubleshooting for ASP.NET-based applications and related components.
  • Maintain proficiency in analyzing browser console errors, network calls, and response payloads to pinpoint issues in customer environments.
  • Participate in proactive system health checks, monitoring server performance metrics and application uptime indicators.


Experience Requirements

  • Minimum 8+ years of customer support experience.
  • ERP/MIS background preferred.
  • Print industry knowledge is mandatory.
  • Experience with tools such as Salesforce, JIRA, and Confluence preferred.
  • Strong understanding of support operations and troubleshooting methodologies.
  • Ability to solve problems efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
  • Self-starter with the ability to work with minimal guidance.
  • Confident in delegating tasks and providing peer guidance.
  • Willing to work in shifts as required.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
  • Strong documentation and organizational abilities.
  • Data analysis skills (reports, dashboards, and metrics).
  • Proficient in general computing, internet research, and email communication.
  • Understanding of web development, SSO, Active Directory, and SSL.
  • Hands-on experience with VPN configuration, network management, and SQL scripting.


Education

  • Degree in Technology, Engineering, or related discipline, or equivalent hands-on experience in customer support and enterprise systems.
  • Strong understanding of software troubleshooting, printing workflows, and IT infrastructure preferred.

title: Consultor(a) SAP ABAP
description:
We Transform. SAP® Solutions into Value


As pessoas são e continuarão sendo uma parte importante dessa missão. Em tudo o que fazemos, nossos funcionários desempenham um papel decisivo para nossos clientes e uns para os outros. É por isso que estamos sempre em busca de profissionais experientes e em início de carreira para se juntarem à nossa equipe.


Fazemos parte do grupo NTT DATA – um dos 10 maiores provedores de tecnologia do mundo – segundo o Gartner, e juntos somos mais de 130.000 colaboradores espalhados em 53 países. Nossa meta é impactar positivamente o mundo ajudando a criar uma sociedade mais conectada, diversa e criativa.


Estamos em busca de um Consultor Desenvolvedor ABAP com experiência em Desenvolvimento e Depuração para integrar nossa equipe de AMS.


Responsabilidade:


O profissional será responsável por fazer análise dos processos desenvolvidos, encontrando falhas e propondo ajustes, desenvolver e manter soluções SAP avançadas, técnicas e garantindo a entrega de alta qualidade atendo diversos clientes de diversos setores.


Formato de Trabalho: Remoto

Contratação: CLT



Requisitos :

  • Conhecimento avançado em Depuração objetos Standards e Desenvolvidos
  • Desenvolver e manter programas complexos em ABAP para atender às necessidades dos clientes.
  • Realizar análise de requisitos e documentação técnica detalhada.
  • Colaborar com equipes funcionais e outros desenvolvedores para transformar requisitos de negócios em soluções técnicas.
  • Garantir a conformidade com as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento SAP e padrões de qualidade.
  • Fornecer suporte técnico avançado e resolução de problemas relacionados às soluções desenvolvidas.
  • Atuar como mentor e líder técnico para desenvolvedores de nível júnior e pleno.
  • Participar ativamente em projetos de implementação e atualização de sistemas SAP.



Formação e experiência desejada:

  • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas relacionadas.

title: Senior Ruby Developer
description:
Location: Remote LATAM

Engagement: Part-time Contractor

Start Date: End of November

Duration: 2 sprints, with strong potential for continued work until June 2026

Schedule: ~25 hours per week


About the Role

We’re looking for a Ruby Specialist with deep experience in Discourse to deliver a fast, clean, and production-ready P1 integration between Discourse and an existing Community application. The integration includes SSO via Okta and OIDC, group and role mapping, backend adapters, shared UI elements, webhook delivery into our analytics stack, and a smooth cutover plan.

This is a high-impact engagement supporting an active squad. You’ll work closely with backend, frontend, security, IT, and data engineering partners to unblock engineers, validate designs, and land the integration safely behind feature flags. If the initial scope goes well, the engagement is expected to extend through mid-2026.

We’re looking for someone proactive, calm under pressure, and comfortable operating in a multi-team environment where clarity and speed matter.


Responsibilities
  • Deliver the P1 Discourse to a Community application integration within two sprints
  • Implement SSO using Okta and OIDC, ensuring secure token handling and session flows
  • Create and test group and role mapping between the Community roles and Discourse groups
  • Build backend Ruby adapters for moderation, taxonomy, and role syncing, gated behind feature flags
  • Implement shared header and navigation elements for a consistent cross-platform experience
  • Create and validate webhook pipelines from Discourse into Snowflake for analytics
  • Develop a clear cutover and rollback plan, including checklists and validation steps
  • Write or review technical designs, threat models, and operational readiness docs
  • Pair with frontend and backend engineers to land adapters, UI integration, and test coverage
  • Coordinate closely with Security and IT on Okta configuration, secrets, and access policies
  • Work with Data Engineering to finalize webhook schemas, retries, and observability
  • Support sprint ceremonies, demos, and unblock teammates on integration or Ruby-related work
  • Ensure all deliverables are tested, documented, and ready for production


Requirements
  • 5+ years of experience with Ruby and Ruby on Rails
  • Strong hands-on experience customizing and extending Discourse
  • Deep understanding of SSO flows (OIDC, OAuth2, Okta) and secure token handling
  • Proven experience delivering integrations behind feature flags or staged rollouts
  • Comfortable writing technical designs, threat models, and operational runbooks
  • Solid experience with APIs, background jobs, webhooks, and data syncing
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills in distributed teams
  • Advanced English


Nice to Have
  • Experience with Snowflake or similar analytics platforms
  • Familiarity with frontend integration of shared headers or cross-app navigation
  • Prior work in enterprise environments that require coordination across IT, Security, and Data teams
  • Experience building rollback strategies and production cutover plans
  • Hands-on experience with DevOps or infrastructure supporting Ruby services

﻿

Why Join

This is a critical, high-visibility integration that will significantly impact how users navigate between Discourse and the Community platform within a large US company. You’ll collaborate with a focused, friendly, and fast-moving team, and you’ll own a deliverable that immediately impacts thousands of users. The work is scoped, essential, and a strong performer will be invited to continue supporting the platform through June 2026.

If you enjoy solving complex integration puzzles, delivering reliable Ruby code, and helping cross-functional teams move faster, this project is an excellent fit.

  • 5+ years of experience with Ruby and Ruby on Rails
  • Strong hands-on experience customizing and extending Discourse
  • Deep understanding of SSO flows (OIDC, OAuth2, Okta) and secure token handling
  • Proven experience delivering integrations behind feature flags or staged rollouts
  • Comfortable writing technical designs, threat models, and operational runbooks
  • Solid experience with APIs, background jobs, webhooks, and data syncing
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills in distributed teams
  • Advanced English


Nice to Have
  • Experience with Snowflake or similar analytics platforms
  • Familiarity with frontend integration of shared headers or cross-app navigation
  • Prior work in enterprise environments that require coordination across IT, Security, and Data teams
  • Experience building rollback strategies and production cutover plans
  • Hands-on experience with DevOps or infrastructure supporting Ruby services

﻿

This is a critical, high-visibility integration that will significantly impact how users navigate between Discourse and the Community platform within a large US company. You’ll collaborate with a focused, friendly, and fast-moving team, and you’ll own a deliverable that immediately impacts thousands of users. The work is scoped, essential, and a strong performer will be invited to continue supporting the platform through June 2026.

If you enjoy solving complex integration puzzles, delivering reliable Ruby code, and helping cross-functional teams move faster, this project is an excellent fit.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
At MAVI, we connect top finance & accounting professionals with high-impact opportunities at US companies. Whether you’re looking for full-time or part-time projects, our network helps you define your next move.


Joining our invite-only network means:


  • Exposure to projects where your work makes a direct impact
  • Premium compensation compared to market alternatives
  • Opportunities with VC-backed startups & established US firms
  • Growth as part of an elite global community of professionals


Before working with clients, candidates complete our vetting process to join the MAVI network.


About the Role


We’ve partnered with a growing early childhood education provider that operates a nationwide network of child care centers. They are hiring a Senior Accountant to oversee end-to-end accounting operations across 20–30 centers and lead the transition from QuickBooks Online to NetSuite.

This is a high-impact role where you’ll combine hands-on accounting with process improvement, helping the organization scale as it continues to expand its footprint.


What You’ll Do


  • Lead and support the transition from QuickBooks Online to NetSuite (~70% complete), ensuring accuracy, compliance, and efficiency
  • Manage full-cycle accounting operations: general ledger, AP, AR, reconciliations, and month-end close
  • Prepare and analyze financial statements, reports, and supporting schedules
  • Maintain and update loan schedules, insurance allocations, and related entries across operating entities
  • Categorize transactions in Ramp, Brex, and other systems (~1 day/month)
  • Provide financial insights and recommendations to management for decision-making
  • Continuously improve accounting processes and leverage NetSuite functionality for efficiency gains
  • Handle other responsibilities typically expected of a Senior Accountant


What We’re Looking For


  • CPA or equivalent preferred
  • 5+ years of progressive, hands-on accounting experience
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP and financial reporting standards
  • Proficiency in NetSuite
  • Familiarity with QuickBooks Online and transition projects from QBO to NetSuite preferred
  • Excellent organizational, time management, and communication skills
  • Ability to operate independently while supporting a multi-entity, growing organization


Why Join Through MAVI?


  • 100% Remote
  • High-impact role supporting a fast-growing education services company
  • Competitive compensation aligned with global opportunities
  • Build your track record within the MAVI network


Selection Process


1️⃣ Initial Interview (20 min) – Meet with Sebastian (Talent Partner) and complete a short accounting exercise

2️⃣ Behavioral Interview (30 min) – Discuss your motivation and fit for working with MAVI clients

Successful candidates join the MAVI Talent Network and gain access to this and future opportunities.


Commitment to Diversity & Inclusion


MAVI provides equal opportunities to all applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or expression.

Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Principais responsabilidades:

Responsabilidades:

• Desenvolver e manter aplicações robustas e escaláveis usando .NET Framework e .NET Core e aplicativos nativos em Flutter.

• Participar em todas as fases do ciclo de vida do desenvolvimento de software, incluindo análise, design, implementação e manutenção.

• Garantir a conformidade dos designs de software com as especificações técnicas e requisitos de negócios.

• Colaborar com equipes multidisciplinares para identificar e resolver problemas complexos de software.

• Conduzir revisões de código e Garantia de qualidade do código com TDD e testes unitários.

• Participar da elaboração de propostas de solução técnica e estimativa de desenvolvimento para elaboração de propostas comerciais.

• Integrar APIs e uso do Firebase para monitoramento e análise de dados.

• Colaborar com equipes ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) com designers e gerentes de produto

• Gerenciar repositórios e versionamento com Git e GitHub/GitLab.

• Documentar de processos e comunicação de progresso para stakeholders.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

- ANDROID

- FLUTTER

- Android SDK

- Android Studio

- iOS Design

- iOS development

- Desenvolvimento para iOS

- Android Architecture Components

- Desenvolvimento de Aplicativos Android

- Java Android

- Arquitetura DevOps e Sustentação de Sistemas

- .NET Framework, SQL Server, MVC, DDD, Unit Tests, API REST, Azure Devops, Azure Cloud.

- .NET (FRAMEWORK E CORE)

- ADVANCED TROUBLESHOOTING

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
We are still looking for talent… and we would love for you to join our team!

For over 25 years, UST has worked alongside the world’s best companies to make a real impact through business transformation. Driven by technology, inspired by people, and guided by our purpose, UST supports clients from design to implementation. Together, with more than 30,000 employees in 30 countries, we build to create limitless impact, reaching billions of lives in the process.


About the Role: we’re looking for a talented Machine Learning Engineer to join our growing AI team!


About the Role

As an ML Engineer on our team, you will design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM models that power autonomous exception resolution, anomaly detection, and explainable insights. You’ll work hands-on with multiple LLM ecosystems like OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, and Meta LLaMA. You will implement retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, develop prompt engineering and safety techniques, and integrate memory and explainability into agentic workflows.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, train, fine-tune, and deploy ML/LLM models for production.
  • Build RAG pipelines using vector databases and frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, and MCP.
  • Develop prompt engineering, optimization, and safety techniques for agentic LLM interactions.
  • Collaborate with data engineering to maintain data pipelines for ML workloads.
  • Conduct feature engineering and embeddings generation on structured and unstructured data.
  • Implement model monitoring, drift detection, and retraining pipelines.
  • Explore emerging LLM/SLM architectures and multi-agent orchestration patterns.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with R&D, data science, product, and engineering teams.
  • Mentor junior engineers and contribute to best practices in ML engineering.


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, or related field.
  • 3+ years building and deploying ML systems.
  • English advance (B2)
  • Strong Python skills and experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, Hugging Face Transformers.
  • Hands-on experience with LLMs/SLMs including fine-tuning, prompt design, and inference optimization.
  • Familiarity with at least two of the following: OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini, Meta LLaMA.
  • Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, and RAG pipelines.
  • Experience working with both structured and unstructured data at scale.
  • Understanding of SQL and distributed data frameworks like Spark or Ray.
  • Deep knowledge of ML lifecycle: data preparation, training, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with agentic frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, MCP, AutoGen).
  • Understanding of AI safety, guardrails, and explainability.
  • Hands-on experience deploying ML/LLM solutions on AWS, GCP, or Azure.
  • Familiarity with MLOps practices including CI/CD, monitoring, and observability.
  • Background in anomaly detection, fraud/risk modeling, or behavioral analytics.
  • Contributions to open-source AI/ML projects or research publications.


UST is waiting for you!

title: Project Manager (Req. English)
description:
Fetchly Labs is a forward-thinking technology company specializing in innovative software solutions and digital products. We operate in a dynamic remote work environment that fosters collaboration and technological advancement across diverse project teams.
Job Responsibilities:
- Lead and manage software development projects from initiation to delivery, ensuring alignment with business goals and technical requirements
- Collaborate closely with product teams to define project scopes, timelines, and deliverables
- Utilize Agile methodologies to plan sprints, coordinate teams, and facilitate meetings
- Prepare comprehensive technical documentation and communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels
- Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks to ensure timely and quality delivery
- Lead cross-functional teams, fostering a productive and motivated work environment
- Monitor project progress and performance metrics, providing regular updates to stakeholders
Required Qualifications:
- 2 to 5+ years of experience in project management and product management roles, preferably in technology or software development
- Proven knowledge of Agile methodologies and project management tools
- Strong technical background with the ability to understand complex product requirements
- Excellent English communication skills, ranging from intermediate to fluent
- College degree in a relevant field; a Master’s degree or higher is preferred
Preferred Qualifications:
- Certification in Project Management (PMP, Scrum Master, or similar)
- Experience working in fully remote teams and across multiple time zones
- Advanced skills in stakeholder engagement and risk management
- Prior exposure to technical writing and documentation best practices

title: SAP HANA & Datasphere Developer (Inglês Fluente)
description:
#Vaga: Desenvolvedor SAP HANA & Datasphere (Remoto – Inglês Fluente)


A Stefanini LATAM está buscando um profissional hands-on com sólida experiência em SAP HANA (on-premise e/ou cloud) para atuar em um projeto internacional com foco em modelagem de dados, performance tuning e integração com SAP Datasphere e SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) .

Este é um papel altamente técnico , voltado à construção de modelos em HANA e Datasphere, além do desenvolvimento de artefatos analíticos que serão consumidos no SAC .

100% remoto

Fuso horário EST

Contrato via Deel (PJ/Contractor)

Início urgente (imediato)

Inglês fluente obrigatório


Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e otimizar modelos SAP HANA (calculation views, graphical/scripted, SQL).
  • Trabalhar com HANA Cloud e integrações com SAP ECC / S/4HANA.
  • Construir e dar manutenção em modelos no SAP Datasphere , integrando-os ao HANA.
  • Conectar e disponibilizar dados para o SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) via live connections.
  • Realizar análises de performance e tuning em HANA e SAC .
  • Traduzir requisitos de negócio em soluções analíticas escaláveis.
  • Participar de POCs envolvendo HANA, Datasphere e SAC.


Requisitos Técnicos

✔ +5 anos com desenvolvimento /consultoria técnica SAP HANA (on-premise ou cloud)

✔ Domínio em:

  • Calculation views
  • SQLScript
  • Joins, unions, projections
  • Performance tuning

✔ Experiência com Datasphere / DWC (camadas, entidades, views, mapping)

✔ Trabalhar com dados oriundos de ECC ou S/4HANA

✔ Vivência com SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC)

✔ Inglês fluente

Diferenciais

  • SAP BW/BW4HANA
  • SAC scripting (JS, R, CSS)
  • Experiência com cenários de Sales/Finance

title: Dev MarTech
description:
Sobre a Posição:


Você será responsável por apoiar a operação de marketing em três frentes principais: criação/otimização de sites e LPs, automatização/integração de sistemas e gestão da jornada do lead/fluxos conversacionais.


  • A vaga é remota/home office, mas logo teremos uma base em Floripa e ter a possibilidade de atuar em formato presencial será um plus;
  • A modalidade é de contratação PJ;
  • Remuneração à ser definida;


Principais Atividades

      → Desenvolvimento e otimização de sites (performance, SEO técnico, conversão)

       → Configuração avançada de rastreamento e análise de dados (GA4, GTM, eventos personalizados)

       → Gestão técnica de ferramentas e fluxos conversacionais (Active Campaign, CRM, Whatsapp)

       → Integração de sistemas de marketing e automação (CRM, e-commerce, ferramentas de automação)

       → Resolução de gargalos técnicos que impedem resultados em marketing digital


      Requisitos Essenciais

  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimento front-end.
  • Conhecimento intermediário em WordPress.
  • Proficiência em HTML, CSS e JavaScript.
  • Experiência em criar websites responsivos e otimizar o desempenho web.
  • Experiência na criação de automações lowcode
  • Habilidade para implementar integrações com APIs.
  • Experiencia com ferramentas de email marketing e CRM, como Active Campaign, RD Station e Hubspot.


     Diferenciais

  • Experiência com ferramentas de versionamento, como Git.
  • Conhecimento em instalação e configuração de tags e eventos no Google Analytics, Google Tag Manager, Google Ads e Facebook.
  • Domínio em práticas de SEO técnico (on-page).
  • Experiência com servidores em nuvem, como AWS e Google Cloud Platform.

title: Azure Cloud Engineer with Bicep
description:
Azure Cloud Engineer with Bicep

Location: Remote (EST Hours)

Contract Duration: 12 months (with possible extension for ongoing needs)


Experience required

Must have 10/10 communication and ability to articulate well.

Azure infrastructure.

*************************Automation via BICEP


Overview:

We are seeking a Cloud Engineer with strong expertise in Azure to support our evolving cloud infrastructure needs following a recent organizational restructure. These roles will help address increased workloads and support cross-functional initiatives within our application and data teams.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to the development, optimization, and automation of Azure-based cloud solutions.
  • Work within a Scaled Agile Framework (SaFE), actively participating in backlog grooming and refinement sessions.
  • Provide technical input and recommendations to improve existing backlog items and identify gaps.
  • Collaborate with application and data teams to ensure infrastructure and network solutions meet project requirements.
  • Support and optimize services within an Application Service Environment (ASE).
  • Configure and manage Private Endpoints and Azure Private Link for secure access.
  • Assist with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) implementation using tools like ARM, Bicep, or Terraform.
  • Troubleshoot network configurations and support secure connectivity between services.


Required Skills & Experience:

  • 3–5 years of hands-on experience with Azure cloud services.
  • Proficiency in Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS), Azure Databricks, and automation tools.
  • Solid understanding of Infrastructure as Code principles and scripting (e.g., PowerShell, Bicep, Terraform).
  • Experience with Private Endpoints, Private Link, and ASE configuration.
  • Basic networking knowledge (VNet, NSGs, routing).
  • Experience working within a SaFE Agile environment and contributing to backlogs.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills

  • Risk anticipation, adaptability & solution-oriented approach

Start : asap

Location : remote

title: Senior Dotnet Developer
description:
Sonata Software Overview

In today's market, there is a unique duality in technology adoption. On one side, extreme focus on cost containment by clients, and on the other, deep motivation to modernize their Digital storefronts to attract more consumers and B2B customers.

As a leading Modernization Engineering company, we aim to deliver modernization-driven hypergrowth for our clients based on the deep differentiation we have created in Modernization Engineering, powered by our Lightening suite and 16-step Platformation™ playbook. In addition, we bring agility and systems thinking to accelerate time to market for our clients.

Headquartered in Bengaluru, India, Sonata has a strong global presence, including key regions in the US, UK, Europe, APAC, and ANZ. We are a trusted partner of world-leading companies in BFSI (Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance), HLS (Healthcare and Lifesciences), TMT (Telecom, Media, and Technology), Retail & CPG, and Manufacturing space. Our bouquet of Modernization Engineering Services cuts across Cloud, Data, Dynamics, Contact Centers, and around newer technologies like Generative AI, MS Fabric, and other modernization platforms.


Role: Sr .Net SQL Developer

Location: Remote in Brazil

Type of Hire: Contract

Senior Developer (.NET/SQL server/AWS)

  • Good in communication and client interaction
  • 10+ years of experience in .NET technologies: .NET core MVC, C#, Entity Framework, Web API, Java Script, jQuery, Bootstrap, SSIS, Kendo, AWS
  • Knowledge on SSIS and Kendo is preferred.
  • Good working experience on DB – SQL and SQL server (Data analysis, writing complex queries, Stored procedures).
  • Good working experience in AWS cloud (like S3, RDS, Lamda, gateway, SQS) is preferred.
  • Participate in all the Scrum Ceremonies (Daily scrum, spring planning, sprint reviews and retrospectives)
  • Requirement gathering and analysis.
  • Story estimations and analysis
  • Performing UI and DB design
  • Coding and unit testing
  • UAT and production bug fixes
  • Deployment of code to Dev/STG
  • Participate in release calls and resolve the issues found.
  • Production support and resolve the issues found.
  • Performing Daily/weekly production monitoring jobs
  • Supporting the associate developers (requirement gathering, analysis, coding, testing and production support)
  • Daily Project Health monitoring.
  • Mortgage / Finance domain experience is a plus.
  • Experience in working with large applications with large volume transactions is a plus.
  • Exposure to AI-driven development and unit testing activities
  • Knowledge of Agile Methodologies, such as Extreme Programming (XP).
  • Experience with relational databases (SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL)
  • Knowledge of design patterns, refactoring, and unit testing
  • Experience with Linux and open-source software is a plus.
  • AWS Environment - EC2, SQS, SNS, Lambda, Containers, API Gateway experience highly preferred
  • Exposure to AI-driven development and QA activities (highly preferred)

Why join Sonata Software?

At Sonata, you´ll have an outstanding opportunity. The chance to use your skills and imagination to push the boundaries of what´s possible. To build never seen before solutions to some of the world’s toughest problems. You´ll be challenged, but you will not be alone. You´ll be joining a team of diverse innovators, all driven to go beyond the status quo to craft what comes next.

Sonata Software is an Equal Opportunity Employer encouraging diversity in the workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, gender identity, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristics protected by law.

title: Desenvolvedor full stack- .Net/ Angular
description:
We are looking for a .NET Developer that has hands-on experience in back-end and front-end areas (.NET Full stack developer with Angular) to be part of our team to support one of our global customers in Canada, which is one of the big 4 professional services firms with headquarters in the UK.


Interested candidates will have the possibility and ability to work in dynamic and distributed environments.



Key Responsibilities:

· Senior (5+ experience) Full stack developer with Angular & .Net Core.

· Strong proficiency with Angular, JavaScript and Typescript and good understanding of web markup, including HTML5, CSS3, JSON, JQuery, AJAX, Bootstrap

· Demonstrated Angular (9 or higher versions) experience in developing maintainable, scalable, cross-browser code that is a delight to experience on any device.

· Strong proficiency in .Net Core, C#, APIs

· Specialized technical knowledge of the SQL technologies.

· Understanding the nature of asynchronous programming and its quirks and workarounds

· Have hands-on experience in a wide range of authentication and authorization technologies.

· Proficient understanding of code versioning tools, such as ADO/GIT and CI/CD

· Experience and working knowledge of Agile Methodology and Test-driven development (TDD)

· Understanding differences between multiple delivery platforms, such as mobile vs. desktop, and optimizing output to match the specific platform

· Understanding of Azure Cloud services, Kubernetes, Dockers.


Good to Have:


· Angular 8/9/10 using Typescript with bootstrap or any other CSS framework.

NET Core 3.x, ASP.NET CORE Web API, REST

· Strong knowledge of ES6 HTML5/CSS 3/ JavaScript

· MS SQL · EF Core / ADO.NET Technology.

· Application Design Patterns / Architecture

· Experience in working with GIT repository

· (Good to have) ReactJS

· (Good to have) Azure DevOps experience( CI/CD Pipelines, Artifacts, Repo)

· (Good to have) Azure cloud development (Web, Databases, AI & Machine Learning,Security, and DevOps)

· Comfortable with Agile methodologies

title: Golang Developer - Relocation to Spain
description:
At CAPITOLE, we keep growing and want to do it with you!


We’re looking for passionate Backend Engineers with at least 3 years of experience in Golang to join our team and take part in a high-impact international project for a top-tier global brand. You’ll work in a modern, collaborative environment where innovation, performance, and scalability are at the heart of everything we build.


The position is fully remote, but you must be based in Spain, with willingness to relocate to Barcelona or Madrid. We take care of processing the highly qualified work permit.


What profile are we looking for?

  • University degree or, equivalently, 5 years of professional experience.
  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in backend development with Golang and a minimum of 2 years of experience in PHP/Symfony, Java/Kotlin or Python.
  • Solid knowledge of RESTful API development.
  • Hands-on experience with Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and Test-Driven Development (TDD).
  • A high level of English is required since you will be working with international teams, and English is the working language.

title: Desenvolvedor
description:
O QUE É SER UM MUTANT?


Quando você decide ser Mutant, você decide dar um passo diferente na sua vida e na sua carreira.


Ser Mutant é aceitar ser parte de um grupo com coragem para traçar novos caminhos e ambição para chegar mais longe a cada dia.


A gente não é a empresa da moda - nem faz questão de ser. Ao contrário, fazemos muito mais do que falamos. E preferimos fazer em grupo porque aqui é com todos e por todos.


Estamos sempre em busca de gente talentosa e apaixonada para crescer e evoluir com a gente. Se você acredita no seu talento e consegue mostrar isso na prática, venha ser um Mutant.


A gente te aguarda.
